question: I'm cataloguing European releases of Counterspell. How many of its printings were released with both a French and an Italian localization? I just need the count as a single number.
evidence: A printing is one release of the card identified by its set and its card number in that set; 'Counterspell' is the English card name as catalogued.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell' AND f.language IN ('French','Italian') AND c.id IN (SELECT c2.id FROM cards AS c2 JOIN foreign_data AS f2 ON c2.uuid = f2.uuid WHERE c2.name = 'Counterspell' AND f2.language = 'French' INTERSECT SELECT c3.id FROM cards AS c3 JOIN foreign_data AS f3 ON c3.uuid = f3.uuid WHERE c3.name = 'Counterspell' AND f3.language = 'Italian')

expected.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell' AND f.language IN ('French','Italian') AND c.id IN (SELECT c2.id FROM cards AS c2 JOIN foreign_data AS f2 ON c2.uuid = f2.uuid WHERE c2.name = 'Counterspell' AND f2.language = 'French' INTERSECT SELECT c3.id FROM cards AS c3 JOIN foreign_data AS f3 ON c3.uuid = f3.uuid WHERE c3.name = 'Counterspell' AND f3.language = 'Italian')
expected.evidence: A printing is one release of the card identified by its set and its card number in that set; 'Counterspell' is the English card name as catalogued.
